map.cos(x,y)=Σxᵢyᵢ/(‖x‖·‖y‖)，取值 [−1,1]，1 为同方: cos(x,y)=Σxᵢyᵢ/(‖x‖*‖y‖), ranging over [-1,1], where 1 means the same direction, 0 orthogonal and -1 opposite.
map.余弦为负说明什么？: What does a negative cosine mean?
map.余弦相似度取值范围 [−1,1]，1 为同向、0 为正交、−1 为反向。因为做了: Cosine similarity ranges over [-1,1], where 1 is the same direction, 0 orthogonal and -1 opposite. Because the magnitudes are normalized, it is insensitive to overall scaling of the vectors, which makes it suitable for comparing text or feature vectors of very different lengths; if you also need to reflect magnitude differences, use Euclidean distance instead.
map.对向量归一化后，余弦等价于内积，计算更快且利于检索索引。: After normalizing the vectors, the cosine equals the inner product, which is faster to compute and convenient for retrieval indexes.
map.归一化后模长均为 1，余弦=内积，便于用内积加速检索(如 FAISS)；且消除向: After normalization every magnitude is 1, so the cosine equals the inner product, which speeds up retrieval (for example with FAISS); it also removes the influence of vector length and focuses on direction.
map.文本/图像嵌入比对几乎都用余弦，因模长常受频率或亮度干扰不代表语义。: Text and image embedding comparison almost always uses the cosine, because the magnitude is often driven by frequency or brightness and does not represent meaning.
map.说明两向量夹角大于 90°，语义倾向相反(如反义句、对立情感)。多数相似度场景只: Indicates the angle between the two vectors exceeds 90°, so the semantics lean opposite (for example antonymous sentences or opposing sentiment). Most similarity scenarios only take the non-negative range, so decide by business rules whether to keep negative values.
map.输入两个向量，计算余弦相似度以衡量方向一致性，适用于文本语义匹配、推荐召回与嵌入: Enter two vectors and compute the cosine similarity to measure directional agreement, which suits text semantic matching, recommendation recall and embedding comparison.
